problem_and_root_cause: A saved +63 mobile number was rebound into a field requiring ten national digits, blocking consent-based transfer.
reproduction: Create and claim a synthetic PDAO record with a canonical +63 phone; transfer it to membership.
fix: Normalize the server-owned initial phone before binding; retain the canonical saved number and immutable source.

problem_and_root_cause: An unscheduled draft raised an exception while formatting report dates.
reproduction: Create a draft without a date; open the program report and export CSV, XLSX and PDF.
fix: Display Not specified for absent dates while retaining Manila formatting for scheduled records.

reproduction: Inject a PostgreSQL unique-violation cause into the duplicate handling path.
fix: Recognize SQLSTATE 23505 and MySQL 1062; propagate unrelated integrity errors.

problem_and_root_cause: Portrait validation accepted a disguised GIF; decoder selection was broader than the allowed formats.
reproduction: Upload a GIF as a portrait and spy on the announcement decoder.
fix: Limit portrait decoding to JPEG/PNG and announcement decoding to the declared allowed format; rewind streams.

problem_and_root_cause: Concurrent requests could render and launch Office together; short cold-start budgets and suppressed error categories reduced reliability.
reproduction: Hold one conversion open, request another, simulate timeout/malformed output/render failure.
fix: Reserve one conversion slot per worker before DOCX rendering; release it in finally; bounded 90 to 180 second budget and sanitized diagnostics.

problem_and_root_cause: The same validation message appeared multiple times.
reproduction: Submit an invalid current registration field and inspect its error list.
fix: Keep one copy of each identical message.

problem_and_root_cause: Document controls appeared in an information-only review; acknowledgement was treated as a profile edit and unchanged information could not be resolved.
reproduction: Review an existing reported change without altering profile values, then repeat with a genuine change.
fix: Remove document-only controls, render optional sections safely and exclude acknowledgement from profile change detection.

problem_and_root_cause: Retained selections performed two queries for each program.
reproduction: Project retained selections for twelve synthetic programs and compare the original projection.
fix: Batch first adoption witnesses and approval lookups without changing eligibility or audit scope.

problem_and_root_cause: Repeated relationship fetches inflated readiness query counts.
reproduction: Evaluate a fully verified synthetic application while counting database queries.
fix: Join required policy, application, previous review and document relationships; preserve all evidence checks.

problem_and_root_cause: Linked-event form initialization mutated the previous-state object; unpublishing expected an archived audit action although the actual transition was draft.
reproduction: Create/edit a linked event and unpublish a program through guarded writers; inject audit failures.
fix: Copy the prior event instance and match the actual draft audit transition.

problem_and_root_cause: The numerator excluded retained finite-capacity non-EWAF programs while the denominator included them.
reproduction: Include finite-capacity historical and current programs in portfolio metrics.
fix: Count applicants consistently across programs with known capacity.

problem_and_root_cause: Case-sensitive reference matching could reject an otherwise exact identity; incomplete evidence presentation indexed a missing status.
reproduction: Repeat identity-checked lookup with a lowercase reference and display a partial evidence record.
fix: Case-insensitive reference comparison with identity checks retained; safe missing-status lookup.

problem_and_root_cause: Published membership guidance was omitted; fallback EWAF copy incorrectly denied numerical ranks.
reproduction: Publish synthetic guidance and open the membership guide; compare explanatory copy with retained ranking output.
fix: Render published guidance and accurately describe advisory numerical ranks and immutable history.

problem_and_root_cause: Login and registration text contrast failures, an empty technical-admin title and a keyboard-inaccessible scrollable onsite guide.
reproduction: Run axe and keyboard checks on login, association registration, admin index and onsite PDAO.
fix: Use palette-compatible contrast colors, add the admin title and make the scrollable guide focusable.
retest_status: PASS: 23-route Chromium, Firefox and WebKit accessibility scans

problem_and_root_cause: Deferred scanner/filter initialization shifted visible content.
reproduction: Measure fresh desktop/mobile loads of dashboard, EWAF and onsite PDAO with layout-shift sources recorded.
fix: Reserve the scanner geometry and match initial filter layouts before deferred initialization; retain no-script behavior.
retest_status: PASS: six focused desktop/mobile layout-shift measurements and full Chromium sweep

problem_and_root_cause: The separately enabled intake adapter did not connect its distinct evidence contract and eligibility requirements to current services.
reproduction: Enable the optional app only in disposable test settings and exercise its separate intake/evidence workflow.
fix: Use an explicit installed-app/feature/contract gate; leave the production current workflow authoritative.

problem_and_root_cause: Many checked-in fixtures still used retired approval routes, missing current required data, old UI selectors or inconsistent synthetic timestamps.
reproduction: Execute the original deployed source suite and compare failures with current documented behavior.
fix: Update synthetic setup and UI selectors, preserve arithmetic oracles and security assertions, align frozen model clocks, and retain published-weight locks. Pin LF checkout for four checksum-verified ranking fixtures; align frozen synthetic model timestamps; exercise historical migrations in separate disposable databases.

problem_and_root_cause: Production requirements pinned Pillow 12.3.0; the advisory scan reported 42 known advisories. The local test environment was already on 13.0.0, masking the release-pin mismatch.
reproduction: Run pip-audit against all 20 flattened production pins, including Windows-excluded Gunicorn.
fix: Pin Pillow 13.0.0; explicitly constrain image decoders; retest uploads and document generation.
